question: Does an LLM add useful semantic inconsistency detection beyond a deterministic rules baseline when auditing listing copy against structured inventory attributes?
hypothesis: Rules + LLM increases actionable issue recall relative to Rules-only while preserving high precision on a human-labeled holdout.
primary_change: introduce semantic claim extraction and contradiction auditing over spots.title/description against spot_attributes
gold_standard: human review; another LLM is not the primary judge

go_no_go.note: Thresholds are design targets to freeze before final labeled holdout evaluation; they are not observed results.

governance_note: The shared Spot2 classification harness is not used because its mandatory AUC/AP/Brier contract is not semantically valid for a data-quality audit. Evidence and reproducibility remain registered through the experiment sandbox.
